title: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. quarterly report for the quarter ended June 30, 2026
excerpt: Q2 revenue was USD 7.814 billion, operating loss was USD 143 million, net loss was USD 541 million, and adjusted EBITDA was USD 3.538 billion; cash plus marketable securities was USD 100.009 billion at June 30, 2026.
summary: The current SEC quarterly filing supplies segment revenue and profit, Starlink subscriber and ARPU, backlog, customer concentration, balance-sheet, cash-flow, capex, debt, share-count, dilution, governance, and risk evidence for the assessment.
